idea-plugin.name: Dataset Downloader
idea-plugin.description:
Dataset Downloader - Streamlined Database Table Exports

A lightweight, high-performance database table exporter for DataGrip and IntelliJ Database Tools. Configure download profiles for your schemas and tables to download them as CSV or Excel (XLSX) files in a single click.

Key Features:

  • One-Click Exports: Save target schemas, tables, and paths as profiles to run downloads instantly.
  • High-Performance Excel Engine: Powered by the ultra-lightweight fastexcel library, reducing memory usage and packaging overhead.
  • OOM Prevention: Handles millions of rows using streaming query cursors and transactional batch fetches.
  • Inline Profile Editor: Manage profiles directly in the grid tool window without interrupting popups.
  • Context-Aware Execution: Run, edit, or delete profiles directly via a convenient right-click context menu.
  • Quick Navigation: Click the "Open Folder" button in the download-complete notification balloon to locate your files instantly.

Supported Formats:

  • CSV: Standard CSV format with UTF-8 BOM, ensuring Korean and other non-ASCII characters display correctly in MS Excel.
  • XLSX: Pure Excel spreadsheets built via a zero-overhead stream writer.

How to Use:

  1. Open the Data Downloader panel on the right sidebar.
  2. Click Add Profile to register your Data Source, Schema, Table, and output directory.
  3. Right-click any profile in the table to execute the download process.
